name: Monofilamental

spells.name: Interplanar Teleport (To Plane of Earth or the Universe Only)
spells.text:
Requirements You have a planar key for the destination plane, used as a locus

---

You and your allies traverse the barriers between planes of existence. The targets move to another plane, such as the Plane of Fire, the Netherworld, or the Outer Rifts. You must know the destination plane exists and use a magic planar key created from material from that plane as a locus for the spell. While the planar keys for most prominent planes are uncommon, just like the spell interplanar teleport, more obscure planes and demiplanes often have rare or possibly even unique planar keys.

The spell is highly imprecise, and you appear 1d20×25 miles from the last place one of the targets (of your choice) was located the last time that target traveled to the plane. If it's the first time traveling to a particular plane for all targets, you appear at a random location on the plane. Interplanar teleport doesn't provide a means of return travel, though casting interplanar teleport again allows you to return to your previous plane unless there are extenuating circumstances.

spells.name: Telekinetic Haul (At Will)
spells.text: You move the target up to 20 feet, potentially suspending it in midair. When you Sustain the Spell, you can do so again, or you can shift your telekinetic focus to a different eligible target within range, moving it instead.

spells.name: Truespeech (Constant)
spells.text:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

---

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.

spells.name: Telekinetic Hand
spells.text:
You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

---

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

spells.name: Telekinetic Projectile
spells.text:
You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

---

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

---

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

items.name: Bloodsense
items.text: A monofilamental can sense flesh and blood within 60 feet as if using the scent ability.

items.name: Cutting Strands
items.text: Slashing damage dealt by the monofilamental bypasses Hardness. An adjacent creature that touches the monofilamental or hits it with a physical attack takes 4d6 slashing damage with a basic DC 36 Reflex save save.

items.name: Glow
items.text: 20 feet. The aura sheds dim light.

items.name: Self-Control
items.text:
Trigger The monofilamental fails or critically fails a saving throw against a mental effect

---
Effect The monofilamental exerts rigid control over its mind. It takes 40 mental damage, which can't be reduced in any way. The triggering save is treated as a success.

items.name: Death Throes
items.text: As the monofilamental dies, it uses Expansion. Afterward, creatures and objects in the area are covered with harmless, crystalline spiderwebs.

items.name: Expansion
items.text: The monofilamental expands its web-like structure before snapping back to its original size. Creatures in a 15-foot emanation take 14d6 slashing,2d6 persistent,bleed damage (DC 36 basic Reflex save save). The monofilamental can't use Expansion again for 1d4 rounds.

items.name: Neural Takeover
items.text:
Frequency once per round

---
Effect The monofilamental hijacks an enemy's neural pathways by overloading them with sensory input. One creature within 60 feet takes 5d8 mental damage with a DC 33 basic Will save save. On a failed save, the creature is also Stunned 1 (or stunned for 1 round on a critical failure).

text:
A monofilamental is a floating bubble made of glowing, crystalline strands. From this complex web of interconnected threads, a highly ordered intelligence emerges, one capable of turning each of its delicate skeins into an unbreakable, serrating lash.

Drifting through the Darklands on subterranean air currents, a monofilamental looks as delicate as a soap bubble or spider web. In fact, the psychic intelligence that animates the monofilamental exerts an unbreakable mental control over each of its strands, granting them unrivaled tensile strength. A single monofilamental thread can slice through steel or stone, to say nothing of the flesh and bone toward which the construct unerringly drifts. If monofilamental thread could be harvested, it would both be a powerful tool and a fearsome weapon; when a monofilamental dies, however, so too does the mental force that fortifies each thread.
Collective Network
Although intelligent, monofilamentals are spun by—and exist only to serve—a species of non-sapient spiders native to the Plane of Earth. Working collectively through instinct, clusters of these extraplanar spiders spin webs of unmatched complexity, some of which awaken to sentience as monofilamentals. Once created, a monofilamental bends its brilliant psychic intellect toward a narrow purpose: fetching meat for its arachnid creators.
